scripts.build: pnpm --filter @voice/contracts build && pnpm --filter @voice/api build && pnpm --filter @voice/web build
scripts.check: pnpm contract:generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint
scripts.contract:check: pnpm contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi packages/contracts/src/api.generated.ts
scripts.contract:generate: pnpm --filter @voice/contracts build && pnpm --filter @voice/api contract:export && pnpm --filter @voice/contracts generate && pnpm --filter @voice/contracts build
